trigger: the point or plan is in Maly or Dulong Bayan I or II or Santa Ana and the planting dates touch July to September (the Habagat flag)
text: Heavy rain and flooding can wash out young trees here in July to September. Plant on higher ground or wait until the rains ease.

trigger: the point or plan has food-bearing trees on a landfill or special reserved square (the rehabilitation-site flag)
text: Prefer bamboo or non-edible trees here. Do not eat or sell fruit from this site without testing.

trigger: the plan has two or more species
text: Keep proper distance between trees so their shade and roots do not compete.

trigger: the species has Low drought tolerance
text: Mulch around the base and water young trees during the dry months (December to May). A shade companion also helps.
source: General practice, to be confirmed by the agriculturist

trigger: the species has Low typhoon resistance (wind tolerance)
text: Plant a windbreak row on the exposed side and stake young trees before typhoon season.
source: General practice, to be confirmed by the agriculturist

trigger: the species is Cacao or Robusta (Coffee) (the species that need shade) and has a listed partner species
text: This tree grows better with shade. Pair it with [partner names].
source: General practice from the partner rules, to be confirmed by the agriculturist

trigger: the species has High shade tolerance and prefers partial shade (the fields the partner rules use) and has a listed partner species but is not Cacao or Robusta (Coffee)
text: This tree tolerates shade, so it can grow under taller trees. Pair it with [partner names].
source: General practice from the partner rules, to be confirmed by the agriculturist

trigger: the species is Cacao (added to the shade advice)
the species has the fruit-bearing purpose tag
text: Ask the nursery for grafted or marcotted stock if it is available. Such trees often fruit earlier.
